prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Inés, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the council might be planning to enforce bin rules more strictly next month, though I'm not sure how true it is. It might be worth keeping an eye on your bins just in case they decide to start checking."
text: The council is officially launching a massive crackdown on all bins starting next month with heavy fines for any violations. Keep your bins perfectly compliant because they are sending out inspectors to check every single house!
